answer: Dawn Vouch Mint requires each new identity to receive a fable of verified human vouchers, pricing coordination by charging a per-voucher fee that scales with the number of identities they support, making it costlier to mint fake identities than to coordinate genuine ones. Jetty Reputation Decay enforces that each identity must contribute to network tasks or lose its vouchers fable, with a daily jetty fee proportional to its activity, ensuring sybils must pay to remain relevant.
